principles.rule: Every canonical page has one primary user purpose and one primary action.
Use emblematic visual hierarchy before explanatory copy where comprehension is not reduced.
Shared information has one canonical home; other pages link to it instead of duplicating it.
Dynamic experiences must expose provenance, freshness and failure state when applicable.
User-created content is draft-first and requires policy, moderation and publication state before public release.
Payments, advertising and participation must disclose price, purpose, eligibility and material terms before commitment.
Investment-like participation is separated from ordinary purchases and remains subject to jurisdiction-specific legal review and required compliance.
Animation and 3D enhance navigation but never become the sole means of understanding or completing an action.
A failed data or action request must never present a false success state.
Content, configuration and deployment changes must have a documented rollback path.
